SBPF VM interpreter core with instruction execution, memory access, syscalls, and fault handling

# Purpose
This file contains the core interpreter for the VM SBPF execution engine. It reads the VM state from `vm`, decodes each instruction from `text`, and executes SBPF opcodes by using a jump table and computed `goto` dispatch. The interpreter handles arithmetic, logic, shifts, loads, stores, branches, calls, syscalls, and exit instructions. It also updates the program counter `pc`, instruction count `ic`, compute units `cu`, and call frame state `frame_cnt` while the program runs.

The file also defines the fault and termination paths for the interpreter. It detects text overrun, invalid instructions, unsupported instructions, stack depth errors, memory access violations, divide errors, syscall errors, and normal exit. For each case, it sets the VM error state and then writes the final execution state back into `vm` before returning. The code also includes logic to match SBPF version rules, syscall handling, shadow stack management, and compute-unit accounting that follows the VM execution model.
